# auto sld

> Browse car dealers and their vehicles, by Richard Hess, built with Solid 2.0.
> The data is generated sample data, not real dealers. No accounts.

The page at / is a Solid single-page app and renders nothing useful without
JavaScript. Use this file instead of scraping it.

## How it works

- Static files on Vercel, built with Vite and `@solidjs/vite-plugin`.
- Data comes from a GraphQL API at `https://gt-forza.vercel.app/graphql`: a
  `Uuid` query gets an id, then a `Solution` query gets the dealers and their
  vehicles for it.
- Pick a dealer (1–5) to see its vehicles. Refresh loads a new set of dealers.
- The data and the picked dealer are saved in localStorage and restored on the
  next visit.
